## Summary

<!-- Briefly describe what this PR introduces or fixes and why -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without behavior change
- [ ] `test`: Unit or integration tests
- [ ] `chore` / `ci`: Tooling, dependencies, or CI/CD configuration

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Code, comments, and docstrings are written in English
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `uv run pytest -v` passes with zero regressions
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or disposable scripts included
